Terrain System

Stable Namespace: `Caffeine::Terrain`, `Caffeine::ECS::TerrainComponent` Files: `src/caffeine/terrain/`, `src/caffeine/ecs/TerrainComponents.hpp` Last verified: 2026-11-18 Source: ecs/TerrainComponents.hpp

The editable heightfield: chunked mesh and LOD, splat painting, coarse collision, the native Terrain Editor and the .cterrain format.

Procedural generation: the Doppio Terrain Generator (C ABI v8); the legacy terrain_plugin is documented in terrain-plugin.md

Overview#

Terrain in Caffeine is an editable heightfield: data in TerrainHeightmap, rendering via TerrainMeshBuilder + per-chunk LOD, splat painting in TerrainSplatmap. The engine does not ship procedural generation in the core. Doppio's Terrain tab builds heightfields with a node graph and places them through the C ABI v8; the legacy terrain_plugin remains for the C++ host.

Separation of responsibilities: the Terrain Editor, sculpt/paint tools and .cterrain I/O are native engine features. Procedural generation lives in Doppio's Terrain tab; the legacy terrain_plugin keeps the C++ host version.

Layer Responsibility
Core Heightmap, mesh, LOD, coarse collision, sculpt/paint, .cterrain
Terrain Editor (native) Sculpt, splat paint, undo and .cterrain import/export
Terrain Generator (Doppio tab) Presets, node graph, splat layers, Place in scene
terrain_plugin (legacy) Node.js algorithm and heightmap import for the C++ host

TerrainComponent#

cpp
struct TerrainComponent {
    u32 resolutionX = 257;
    u32 resolutionZ = 257;
    u32 splatResolutionScale = 2;          // splatmap is coarser than the heightmap
    f32 worldSizeX = WorldUnits::kDefaultTerrainSizeM; // metres (1 u = 1 m)
    f32 worldSizeZ = WorldUnits::kDefaultTerrainSizeM;
    f32 maxHeight = WorldUnits::kDefaultTerrainHeightM;

    u32 dataRevision = 1;                  // bumped when heights/splat change
    u32 meshRevision = 0;
    u32 splatRevision = 1;
    bool castShadows = true;
    bool receiveShadows = true;

    char texturePath[256];                 // default ground albedo
    char normalMapPath[256];               // triplanar normal map (GPU)
    f32  textureTileSize = 8.0f;
    f32  shininess = 16.0f;                // legacy; terrain shading has no specular
    Vec3 tint{1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f};           // multiplies the sampled albedo

    bool useSplatmap = true;
    char splatLayerPaths[4][256];          // Grass, Rock, Sand, Dirt defaults
    f32  splatTileSize = 8.0f;

    bool useChunks = true;
    u32 chunkVertexCount = 33;
    u32 maxLodLevels = 2;
    bool frustumCull = true;
    f32 lodDistanceScale = 520.0f;
    f32 lodHysteresis = 0.25f;

    u32 collisionSampleStep = 4;           // 4 = ~16x fewer triangles
    bool buildCollisionMesh = true;

    char terrainDataPath[256];             // .cterrain path in the project
};

The internal heightmap stores normalised values [0, 1]. In the mesh, y = sample * maxHeight.

Data pipeline#

  • TerrainComponent (ECS)
  • ▼
  • TerrainCache::initializeEntity / syncEntity
    • TerrainHeightmap (CPU, editable)
    • TerrainSplatmap (4 layers)
    • Mesh3D render (TerrainMeshBuilder + tangents)
    • Mesh3D collision (TerrainCollisionMeshBuilder, decimated)
    • TerrainChunk[] (LOD + frustum cull)

TerrainMeshBuilder#

  • Generates vertices with the heightmap normal (sampleNormalBilinear).
  • UVs tiled according to textureTileSize / splatTileSize.
  • Tangents calculated per triangle (base for normal mapping).

Collision#

TerrainCollisionMeshBuilder reuses buildRegion with collisionSampleStep (for example 4 → ~16× fewer triangles). Access it through TerrainCache::collisionMeshFor(entity).

Editor#

Panel Function
Inspector → Terrain Resolution, size, LOD, splat, collision, Normal Map, Shininess
Terrain Editor (native) Sculpt (raise/lower/smooth/flatten/noise), splat paint, import/export .cterrain

Native Terrain Editor#

Open it from View → Terrain Editor, the command palette (Terrain Editor), or the Open Terrain Editor button in the Toolbox while a Terrain entity is selected.

Tool Behaviour
Raise / Lower Adds or removes height with a smooth falloff
Smooth Averages the local neighbourhood
Flatten Flattens to the height under the first click of the stroke
Noise Adds deterministic detail
Splat paint Paints Grass, Rock, Sand or Dirt weights
Reset default textures Restores the default paths and the Grass layer
Data tab Edits the .cterrain path and imports/exports the file

Fast strokes are interpolated between frames instead of stamping only once per frame. Undo/redo snapshots include the heightmap and splatmap, so Ctrl+Z restores terrain edits instead of resetting the terrain to flat.

New terrains start with the Grass layer and natural 1k ground textures from assets/hdr-assets-texture (dirt/rock/moss, rocks, dirt and mud). The Inspector Tint colour multiplies the sampled albedo.

Scenes authored before this default stored an unpainted terrain as the old Light layer. Loading such a .cterrain migrates the uniform Light splatmap to Grass and upgrades the untouched Kenney prototype paths to the natural ground set automatically.

Procedural generation: panel Terrain Generator (plugin). The plugin does not own sculpting or painting.

GPU rendering#

With CF_HAS_SDL3, terrain uses terrain_lit.frag:

  • Lambert diffuse plus sky IBL; the surface is a rough dielectric, with no specular lobe.
  • Normal map triplanar via the terrain GPU texture cache (sampler slot 5).
  • Directional shadows (slots 6–7), point cubemaps (slots 8–9) and spot maps (slots 10–11).
  • Splat map on slot 0, the four layers on slots 1–4.
  • castShadows / receiveShadows are read in GpuSceneRenderer::gatherMeshDraws.

See rendering/materials-phong.md and rendering/shadow-mapping.md.

Serialization#

SceneSerializer writes TerrainComponent into the scene blob (terrain blob version 11). Version 9 added collisionSampleStep and buildCollisionMesh; version 10 added normalMapPath and shininess; version 11 added tint. Legacy generation fields (v2–v8) are read and discarded for compatibility. Heavy height/splat data live in the .cterrain referenced by terrainDataPath.

Useful API#

cpp
TerrainCache& cache = TerrainCache::instance();
cache.initializeEntity(world, entity);
cache.heightmapFor(entity)->setNormalized(x, z, h);
cache.syncEntity(world, entity);

Terrain::importHeightmapFile(world, entity, path, worldSizeX, worldSizeZ);
